definitions.explanation: Describes movement with short, quick steps, typically of small children or animals.
Doing something many times in small amounts rather than all at once.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がちょこちょこ{走|はし}っている。
examples.english: The child is running with small, quick steps.

examples.japanese: {子犬|こいぬ}がちょこちょこと{付|つ}いてきた。
examples.english: The puppy followed along with tiny steps.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんがちょこちょこ{歩|ある}く{姿|すがた}がかわいい。
examples.english: The way the baby toddles along is cute.

examples.japanese: ネズミがちょこちょこと{部屋|へや}の{隅|すみ}を{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っていた。
examples.english: A mouse was scurrying around the corner of the room with quick little steps.

examples.japanese: {小|ちい}さな{女|おんな}の{子|こ}がちょこちょこと{母親|ははおや}の{後|あと}を{追|お}いかけていた。
examples.english: A little girl was following after her mother with quick little steps.

examples.japanese: ちょこちょこ{買|か}い{物|もの}に{行|い}く。
ちょこちょこ{休憩|きゅうけい}を{取|と}りながら{仕事|しごと}をする。
examples.english: I work while taking frequent short breaks.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}ちょこちょこミスが{出|で}ているので{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: Small mistakes have been popping up lately, so please be careful.

examples.japanese: まとめて{買|か}った{方|ほう}がいいのに、ちょこちょこ{買|か}い{足|た}してしまう。
examples.english: I should buy things in bulk, but I keep making small purchases bit by bit.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}がちょこちょこ{家|いえ}に{遊|あそ}びに{来|く}るので、いつも{部屋|へや}をきれいにしている。
examples.english: My friend comes to visit frequently, so I always keep my room clean.

notes:
TYPE: Mimetic word (gitaigo) describing manner of movement or frequency.

NUANCE BY SENSE:
- Sense 1: Visual image of quick, short-legged movement. Often cute or endearing.
- Sense 2: Doing small amounts repeatedly. Can imply inefficiency.

TYPICAL SUBJECTS (Sense 1):
- Small children (toddlers)
- Small animals (puppies, kittens)
- Small birds
- People with short legs

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ちょこちょこ{歩|ある}く (to walk with small steps)
- ちょこちょこ{動|うご}く (to move about quickly)
- ちょこちょこ{出|で}かける (to go out frequently)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ぱたぱた: pitter-patter (footsteps)
- とことこ: toddling along
- ひょこひょこ: with a bobbing motion
